## TraceGuard v2 (Data Table storage)
Create ONE data table named **tg_events** with ONE string column named **payload**.
Then open each node named 'Load Log...' / 'Save ...' (5 nodes) and select that table.
Publish (activate) and use the PRODUCTION urls.
